output_text: "The project will test the effects of both types of cigarette on volunteers' blood vessel function, recruiting 135 adult smokers who have smoked 15 cigarettes a day for at least two years. Participants will be divided into three groups: one continuing to smoke tobacco cigarettes, another switching to e-cigarettes containing nicotine and tar, and a third switching to e-cigarettes containing only flavor. The study aims to determine whether e-cigarettes are safer for blood vessel function compared to traditional cigarettes, despite the presence of nicotine, which may be harmful to blood vessels."
